source.label: STOPP/START v3 (O'Mahony et al., Eur Geriatr Med 2023), CC BY 4.0

rules.summary: First-generation antihistamine in an older adult
rules.detail: Strongly anticholinergic and sedating: confusion, falls, constipation and urinary retention. STOPP/START v3 advises avoiding it; a non-sedating antihistamine, or sleep measures for insomnia, are alternatives.
Raises the risk of sedation, confusion, falls and fractures; STOPP/START v3 flags use beyond 4 weeks and in patients who fall.

rules.summary: Z-drug hypnotic in an older adult
rules.detail: Z-drugs raise the risk of falls and fractures (STOPP/START v3).

rules.summary: Long-acting sulfonylurea in an older adult
rules.detail: Risk of prolonged hypoglycemia; STOPP/START v3 names glibenclamide (glyburide) and glimepiride.

rules.summary: Tricyclic antidepressant in an older adult
rules.detail: Anticholinergic, sedating and can cause orthostatic hypotension and falls (STOPP/START v3).
Higher risk of GI bleeding, kidney injury and heart failure; STOPP/START v3 flags NSAIDs with reduced kidney function, heart failure or an anticoagulant.
